findings: learner.overview.text: State directly that 绍 is the simplified form of 紹, and that the 糸 + 召 construction belongs to traditional 紹. The current wording calls 绍 simplified but then says “Its traditional form combines” the components, leaving the relationship unclear in this first-reading layer. Supported by E2, E6, E7, X-df098421fb2b9c543b20.

history[1].text: Name both readings of the old-form account: 綤 written with 邵, and the differing commentary reading 卪. The current “connects 綤 with 邵” omits the documented disagreement. Preserve the statement that no graphic sequence is established. Supported by X-6aeb485636f9918ecd11, X-e85b6d5baa544f59eb0d, X-8b0f74e5832f585413ec.
